name: RCTA - Metal Gear [FORTNITE]
teaser: The Metal Gear collab outfits from Fortnite (but not cringe)
description:
**RCTA - Metal Gear [FORTNITE]

**

Mod Description

  • Basically every outfit (excluding the masks) from the Metal Gear Fortnite collab, I know “fortnite” leaves a bad taste but don’t let it scare you away, they’re modeled beautifully and I made sure the proportions fit perfectly to the T***** body. The textures left untouched fit perfectly fine too! METAL GEAR!!!

Mod Includes

  • RCTA Old Snake [Top] (B*/U***) (RAGMAN)**
  • RCTA Old Snake [Bottom] (B*/U***) (RAGMAN)**
  • RCTA Raiden [Top] (B*/U***) (RAGMAN)**
  • RCTA Raiden [Bottom] (B*/U***) (RAGMAN)**
  • RCTA Snake Top [Top] (B*/U***) (RAGMAN)**
  • RCTA Snake Top [Bottom] (B*/U***) (RAGMAN)**
